agent.problem: Cards 2, 4 and 6 require discovering details that the earlier cards do not help the baker infer: Seir, whether the cry is repeated and what the watchman answers. Even treating cards 3 and 8 as reasoned picks, three of the five choice cards are discovery questions, so most choice cards are not informed guesses.

rule.text: A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.
